hyps.why: Pooled input to node 1 benefits more from learned 3x3 filtering than already-convolved features do.
With edge 0 removed, node 1 carries no signal so a conv on edge 4 has nothing to transform.
Replacing none with skip adds a whole new gradient path, whereas replacing avg_pool only swaps one parameter-free path for another.
A direct skip path makes the extra conv on the chain redundant.
Parallel convs into node 3 saturate so a second one adds less.
A 1x1 on a parallel edge complements the 3x3 by adding channel mixing at a different scale.
Stacked 3x3 convs give diminishing returns compared to pool-then-conv.
Without the direct shortcut, edge 4 is a primary route to the output so its capacity matters more.
Adding a blurring pool path beside a strong conv path contributes little and can dilute features.
When edge 3 is none, edge 0 feeds the only route to the output so its quality matters more.
